options.content:
### 📥 Inbound connections to pods
One record per new inbound TCP connection (SYN) and per inbound UDP/ICMP flow (ongoing UDP is re-reported every few seconds). **Peer**: *internet* = public addresses, *lan* = home network & tailnet, *cluster* = pods and API server, *node* = node addresses (mostly kubelet health probes, excluded by default). No ingress policy is enforced yet.

targets.expr: kubernetes.container_name:cilium-agent flow.event_type.type:4 flow.destination.pod_name:~"." flow.destination.namespace:~"^${dst_namespace}$" | format "cluster" as peer | format if (flow.source.namespace:"" and flow.source.identity:in("1","6")) "node" as peer | format if (flow.source.namespace:"" and not flow.source.identity:in("1","3","4","5","6","7","8")) "internet" as peer | format if (peer:internet and (flow.IP.source:ipv4_range("10.0.0.0/8") or flow.IP.source:ipv4_range("172.16.0.0/12") or flow.IP.source:ipv4_range("192.168.0.0/16") or flow.IP.source:ipv4_range("100.64.0.0/10"))) "lan" as peer | filter peer:in($peer) | format "<flow.destination.pod_name>" as dst_app | replace_regexp ("-[a-z0-9]{6,10}-[a-z0-9]{5}$", "") at dst_app | replace_regexp ("-[0-9a-f]{32}$", "") at dst_app | format "<flow.destination.namespace>/<dst_app>" as destination | format "<flow.source.pod_name>" as src_app | replace_regexp ("-[a-z0-9]{6,10}-[a-z0-9]{5}$", "") at src_app | replace_regexp ("-[0-9a-f]{32}$", "") at src_app | format "<flow.source.namespace>/<src_app>" as source | format if (peer:in(internet, lan)) "<flow.IP.source>" as source | format if (peer:node) "node <flow.IP.source>" as source | format if (flow.source.identity:"7") "kube-apiserver" as source | format "<flow.l4.TCP.destination_port><flow.l4.UDP.destination_port>" as port | format "<flow.l4.TCP.destination_port>" as tport | format "<flow.l4.UDP.destination_port>" as uport | format "icmp" as proto | format if (not uport:"") "udp" as proto | format if (not tport:"") "tcp" as proto | format "same namespace" as relation | format if (not flow.source.namespace:"" and not flow.source.namespace:eq_field(flow.destination.namespace)) "cross-namespace" as relation | format if (peer:in(internet, lan, node) or flow.source.identity:"7") "<peer>" as relation | format if (flow.source.identity:"7") "api-server" as relation | stats count() n

panels.title: Inbound drops by reason
panels.description: SERVICE_BACKEND_NOT_FOUND = connections to the public IP on ports nothing listens on (scanners). POLICY_DENIED = refused by an ingress NetworkPolicy (e.g. argocd-redis).

targets.expr: kubernetes.container_name:cilium-agent flow.verdict:DROPPED flow.traffic_direction:INGRESS | stats by (flow.drop_reason_desc) count() n

kubernetes.container_name:cilium-agent flow.verdict:DROPPED flow.traffic_direction:INGRESS | format "<flow.l4.TCP.destination_port><flow.l4.UDP.destination_port>" as port | stats by (flow.IP.source, flow.drop_reason_desc) count() packets, count_uniq(port) ports, max(_time) last_seen | sort by (packets desc) | limit 100
